coverage: Entity, historical Participant and two-channel expansion capacity refuse the original accepted actor plan without reservation or topology IO.

A real new second caller reuses one committed generation; its fresh private channel exceeds the original four-channel allowance and returns channel-capacity without adding a contact/Person/Participant/Session/Channel.

Complete reservation bytes deny before preparation; complete commit batch bytes deny after actual confirmed Participant/Channel IO and retain the original preparing reservation, maintenance and request. The original 4096 allowance is never raised; a fixed long runId makes the two-record batch exceed it.

Director and representative predictive Native token admission stop exactly one token below the next original 10000-token reservation; actual completed requests each report 15 tokens and share the original run ledger.

A real foreign Simulation run holds one actual provider request under the same model pool, with its own 10000-token Native reservation retained as unknown after explicit terminal provider failure. Target director/representative records the actual durable shared-pool refusal before downstream inference.
Director/representative activation history uses two real model-free warmups and preserves confirmed cleanup, exact maxActivations admission details and original pending work across cold processes.

Resident coverage is an actual owner ensureResident capacity refusal with evict:[] under one occupied slot, repeated three times without append/inference. The ordinary driver subsequently evicts a legal idle writer and completes; this is not a persistent driver resident stall.
generation: Finite Persona selection uses the actual director plan turn. There is no extra free-form generation provider stream to omit from the measured ledger.
deferred: Unconfirmed provider termination and persistent resident recovery remain owned by the separate existing residency matrix; this fixture records a historical owner boundary.
It does not claim all auxiliary/compaction or open-ended generation fault branches, a real-adapter budget, or a configurable per-key generation turnover quota.
Cancellation/unknown topology IO/crash recovery remains X12; completed checkpoint/suffix quota recovery does not substitute for that fault matrix.
